title: Devendra Kumar Bansal v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J.; Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to objections on provisional assessment and Code remedies.
headnote: Allahabad High Court declined to entertain a writ seeking constitution of a committee under Clause 8.0(5) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 to inquire into inspection procedure, after a provisional assessment notice had been served. The consumer was left to raise all objections, including as to the checking procedure, in reply to that notice or under the Code.
facts: Devendra Kumar Bansal sought a writ directing the respondents to constitute a committee under Clause 8.0(5) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 to inquire into the procedure allegedly adopted by respondent no. 4 during an inspection. Counsel stated on oral instructions that a provisional assessment notice had already been served. The petitioner had also made a representation against the inspection procedure (Annexure-6).

holding_units.topic: committee to inquire into inspection procedure
holding_units.holding: A writ seeking constitution of a committee under Clause 8.0(5) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 to inquire into inspection procedure will not be entertained once a provisional assessment notice has been served; the consumer may raise all objections, including as to the checking procedure, in reply to that notice or pursue the remedies under the Code.

not_decided.point: Whether the inspection procedure adopted by respondent no. 4 was irregular or warranted a Clause 8.0(5) inquiry committee
not_decided.note: Left to objections against the provisional assessment notice or other Code remedies.
